title: Living-Infrastructure material and process identities
reason: The Living Infrastructure program registration in kueper-ecosystem (docs/programs/living-infrastructure.md) assigns material and process identities to the Knowledge Graph. The Engineering flow contract, OTA evidence work and later Universe/Game consumers need canonical identities for substrates, mycelium, compost, nutrient cycling and water reclamation; without them each domain would invent its own terms and the integration layer would have no shared vocabulary.
requested_change: Define or align canonical entity, relation and unit identities for living-infrastructure materials and processes in kueper-knowledge-graph, including substrates, mycelium, compost, nutrient cycling and water reclamation. Map them to existing KG domains and the Mars Settlement Systems Kernel entity set, reuse existing IDs where they exist, and document gaps instead of creating duplicates. Add mapping rules for biological, agricultural, waste and recycling processes. Keep identities at KG level; do not import unverified or fictional claims as canonical.
expected_result: A bounded, reviewed set of canonical living-infrastructure material/process identities, relations and units exists in the KG with mapping and provenance hooks, and the program registration can reference it instead of a prose-only vocabulary.
